build_model_from_config: build a model instance from the config using the build_model function
build_loss_function: build a loss function instance from the config using the build_loss_fun function
register_custom_model: register a custom model class with a name using the register_model function
register_custom_loss: register a custom loss function class with a name using the register_loss_fun function
get_model_class: get the model class for a config-specified model type using the get_model function
